mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_alert_instance WHERE 1=1 AND instance_severity=#{query.level} AND instance_status IN ('PENDING','FIRING','ACKNOWLEDGED','SUPPRESSED','ESCALATED') AND instance_status=#{query.status} AND id=#{query.alertId} AND cluster_id=#{query.clusterId} ORDER BY FIELD(instance_severity,'P0','P1','P2','P3'),fired_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM t_alert_instance WHERE id>#{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM t_alert_instance WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT instance_status FROM t_alert_instance WHERE id=#{id}
